title: Cohort Coach: synthesize batch recommendations from compacted workload signals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build 'Cohort Coach', a recommendation engine that compacts high-cardinality workload signals into robust cohort profiles and synthesizes safe, continuously-updating batching & KV-cache parameter proposals with automated shadow apply and rollback gates. The feature should produce actionable configs that reduce per-token cost while preserving 99th-percentile latency SLOs across model families and deployment types. Output must integrate with Redwood Console for per-route suggestions and with the autoscaler/policy layer for staged apply.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort Coach ingests request-level telemetry (route, model, seq_len, kv-hit, arrival pattern) and produces stable cohort fingerprints covering >=85% of production traffic within 24h of rollout
Generated recommendations include batch_size, max_latency_target_ms, kv_cache_ttl, prefix_cache_enabled flags and an estimated cost delta and risk score
Shadow apply mode runs for at least 72h with no >1% increase in 99th p99 latency or error-rate for any cohort before canary apply
Rollback triggers are implemented: automatic rollback on latency or error regressions exceeding thresholds, and audit logs visible in Console
End-to-end E2E tests and offline simulator validate recommendations across synthetic bursts and KV-miss scenarios
Docs and Console UX show recommendations with rationale, confidence, and links to profiling traces
tasks: Design cohort fingerprint schema and compression strategy (time-decayed histograms + learned sketches)
Implement ingest pipeline to compact signals into cohort store and expose query API
Develop rule synthesizer that maps cohort stats to batch/cache parameter candidates
Integrate simulator to estimate cost/latency tradeoffs for each candidate
Build safety gates: shadow apply, phased canary, automatic rollback, manual approval flow
Hook recommendations into Console suggestions UI and add telemetry for decision attribution
Add RBAC + audit logging for automated applies to Dedicated/Private deployments
Run load tests and small multitenant pilots, collect feedback, iterate
experiment_plan: Stage 0: offline replay and simulator scoring against last 14 days of traffic
Stage 1: shadow apply for top-5 cohorts by traffic for 72h and compare real vs simulated metrics
Stage 2: 1% canary apply with automated rollback window of 6h and extended observation of 72h
Stage 3: gradual rollout to ~25% traffic with periodic re-evaluation and cohort re-compaction
Stage 4: full apply with weekly re-synthesis and an opt-out API for customers
rollout_plan: Start with internal tenant + one low-risk customer. Use shadow apply for 72h, then 1% canary for 6h with automated rollback triggers (latency or error regression). If stable, expand to 25% over 3 days, then to 100% by week 2 with continuous monitoring. All applies require signed audit entry and owner oncall.
rollback_plan: Automatic rollback when any cohort sees >1% absolute increase in 99th p99 latency or >0.5% relative increase in error_rate OR when cost savings are negative beyond an internal threshold. Manual rollback via Console with prepopulated revert config. Revert includes warmup to previous KV cache profiles to avoid cold-start spikes.
